name: Northwest Pipeline Sundance Trail Expansion
monitor_reason: length: operator release (via World Pipelines and NS Energy, one origin) says about 15.5 mi of 30 in pipe, which is 24.9 km, under the 25 km floor; EIA Aug 2026 rounds to 16 mi (25.7 km). Sourced length is borderline and the primary statement is below the floor.
researcher_notes: No existing GEM row: the five Northwest Gas Pipeline rows (P0230, P2626, P5101, P7790, P7812) are the main line and other projects, none is Sundance Trail. Project is real and complete: 30 in loop between Green River and Muddy Creek, Wyoming, plus Vernal compressor work in Utah, FERC docket CP09-415, certificate December 2009, built from April 2010, in service November 2010, about 56 million USD, 150,000 Dth/d. EIA Aug 2026 Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 669, project name NWPL Sundance Trail Expansion: 16 mi, 30 in, 150 MMcf/d, cost 59.4 million, completed 2010-11. Operator figure of 15.5 mi (24.9 km) is just under the 25 km rule, so classed monitor. If Baird wants borderline lengths admitted, stage as expansion row with PipelineName Northwest Gas Pipeline, SegmentName Sundance Trail Expansion, LengthKnown 15.5 or 16 mi, 30 in, operating, no route research done. Owner Northwest Pipeline LLC checked with entity_lookup (no change to style); parent Williams not researched. The FERC order itself was not opened.
